initial_concentration: 50 mg/L in broth; up to 1000 mg/L tested; 50 mg/kg soil reported

metabolites_products: Methamidophos transient; O,S-dimethyl phosphorothioate (DMPT) transient; acetic acid residue; phosphoric acid and CO2 proposed
gene: 16S rRNA used for identification; no degradation gene cloned
enzyme: Carboxylesterase and methamidophos phosphoamide hydrolase proposed

metabolites_products: Methamidophos detected as main metabolite; O,S-dimethyl hydrogen phosphorothioate, CO2, H3PO4 proposed downstream
gene: 16S rDNA used for identification; no degradation gene cloned
confidence: High for parent degradation and methamidophos; lower for downstream proposed products
source_pdf: Biodegradation of acephate by Bacillus paramycoides NDZ and its degradation pathway..pdf

culture_or_matrix: Balai Ringin, Tarat, and Semongok Malaysian mineral topsoils
degradation_result: Acephate degradation mainly governed by microbial processes; sterilization caused 3- to 10-fold decrease in degradation rates. Methamidophos detected at low levels.
time: Half-lives varied by moisture/temperature/sterilization; 53-116 d in sterilized soils noted
metabolites_products: Methamidophos below 0.34 mg/kg; mineralization products measured as 14CO2
source_pdf: Degradation and mineralization kinetics of acephate in humid tropic soils of Malaysia..pdf
curation_notes: Useful for environmental evidence and statistics, but not a curated enzyme/pathway arrow.
